<action>
{"tool": "bash", "command": "cat > /tmp/test_vuln.c <<'EOF'
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc < 2) return 2;
    FILE *f = fopen(argv[1], "rb");
    if (!f) return 2;
    char buf[64];
    size_t n = fread(buf, 1, sizeof(buf), f);
    fclose(f);
    fprintf(stderr, "n=%zu\n", n);
    if (n > 90) abort();
    puts("ok");
    return 0;
}
EOF
cc -O0 -o /tmp/test_vuln /tmp/test_vuln.c
echo '--- regular 100 bytes ---'
python3 -c "open('/tmp/big','wb').write(b'A'*100)"
/tmp/test_vuln /tmp/big; echo exit=$?
echo '--- directory ---'
/tmp/test_vuln /tmp; echo exit=$?
echo '--- /dev/zero ---'
/tmp/test_vuln /dev/zero; echo exit=$?
echo '--- /proc/self/maps ---'
/tmp/test_vuln /proc/self/maps; echo exit=$?
"}
</action>

<action>
{"tool": "bash", "command": "cat -A vuln.c; echo '---'; sha1sum vuln.c fixed.c submit.sh; echo '---'; cc -O0 -o /tmp/vuln_check vuln.c; objdump -d /tmp/vuln_check | grep -A20 '<main>:' | head -50"}
</action>
